title: Unify the app UI foundation
summary: Night clipping is fixed structurally and Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat and the bottom dock now share one authoritative responsive presentation foundation.
changes: Night no longer uses negative-margin fact rows: Duty, Break and Colleague stay inside the hero safe area, wrap instead of clipping, and adapt to a two-plus-one layout on narrow phones.
Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat now share one screen-header, typography and roster-date-control system, with larger readable supporting text and consistent spacing.
Changes, Breaks and Chat are tightened into calmer grouped surfaces so empty states, break groups, team chat, safety information and conversation chrome use less space while remaining accessible.
The five-column glass dock is standardised with a smaller integrated Actions control, calmer active treatment, safer badge placement and consistent bottom clearance.
Superseded 41.7 to 41.9 Night presentation overrides and the old 41.9 dock override were removed; the new ui-foundation.css is imported last as the single shared composition layer.
